sources.title: 臺北市政府環境保護局行人專用清潔箱設置管理作業程序（已廢止／停止適用）
excerpts: The legal-system record says it stopped applying from 2022-08-24.
The then-procedure defined responsible district teams, direct team and environmental-cleaning section; covered installation, relocation, removal, GPS reporting and maintenance.

It said each box should carry a box number and be registered; new installation/removal/relocation required site review, approval and a form; installation/relocation GPS and a register file were sent the same day; the central section submitted citywide deployment/management reports every two months.

sources.title: 2021-02-02 historical version of the procedure
excerpts: The 2021 version specifies site review, a setting/repair application, the same-day managed-register file for installation/relocation, GPS update transmission, and bimonthly reporting.

sources.title: 2021 procedure amendment explanation
excerpts: The 2021 revision was effective 2021-02-02 and said forms were to be prescribed by the environmental-cleaning section.

interpretation: Procedural existence of numbered boxes and internal records is evidenced for the historical period. Public release, current process after 2022-08-24, current retention, and linkage to either snapshot remain unverified. A location row is not proven to equal one physical box.
